Initial release—Agentic Workflow Designer 1.0.0

- Launches the Agentic Workflow Designer skill for mapping, automating, and optimizing multi-step business processes.
- Supports workflow discovery, automation opportunity assessment, agentic pipeline design, and ROI prediction.
- Provides blueprints and generates import-ready workflow specs for n8n, Make, and Zapier.
- Recommends suitable automation platforms and designs human-in-the-loop (HITL) checkpoints.
- Targeted for operations managers, developers, consultants, and entrepreneurs seeking AI-powered workflow automation.
